facts: fixed eight experts created at initialization
forward computes all eight expert updates and softmax-weighted sum
CL method provides no separate training_loss or extra_loss; original training entry uses answer_loss on combined output
top2 used in end_stage to set momentum merge, not sparse forward dispatch
inference effective gate is 0.5 token softmax plus 0.5 selected task mean gate
interpretation: no hard disjoint task assignment; shared answer objective is a plausible source of functional overlap
causality: not proven: removing shared exposure or changing routing training has not been tested
scope: source-bound implemented CL-MoE reproduction; not a claim about all MoE methods
